name: banza-trust
description: banza-trust (ADR-038, R5; M2.4): the Rust BANZA trust verifier for the open financial protocol. Ed25519 + ADR-025 canonical-JSON evaluation of signed protocol metadata, delegated signing keys, operator manifests, conformance evidence, the public protocol registry and revocation/fail-closed. Verification only — no key generation for production, no signing of production artifacts, no operator authorisation, certification or approval.
